title: Quant QC sentinel with delta telemetry for automated calibration validation
creator: Asha Raman
description: Build a lightweight, automated QC sentinel that validates quantized model profiles (FP8/INT8) against a float32 baseline using a curated set of golden stimuli and delta-based telemetry. The sentinel should run in CI and on a nightly cadence for Dedicated/Private customer images. It must compute a concise pass/fail signal that combines multiple metrics (generation divergence, embedding drift, logprob shifts) and support dynamic pass/fail thresholds derived from rolling historical percentiles per-model and per-workload. The goal is to prevent silent regressions after calibration/quantization while minimizing false positives that block rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: QC sentinel runs as a CI job for PRs touching quantization code and as a scheduled job in staging (nightly)
Generates an artifact per run (summary JSON) with: model id, quant profile, stimuli set hash, sample-level metrics, aggregated deltas, and pass/fail verdict
Pass/fail decision composes: token-level average logprob delta, n-gram overlap delta, embedding cosine drift, and distributional logit shift. Weights are configurable per-model
Dynamic thresholds computed from 30-day rolling percentile (default 95th for deltas) and overridable per-release
Integration with canary rollout: failing sentinel marks canary as unhealthy and triggers automated fallback to float variant for traffic above configured risk threshold
Dashboard panel exists with historical run trends and a drilldown to failed prompts and their diffs
On first full run in staging, false-positive rate <= 5% on a labeled validation subset and signal latency <= 20m for scheduled runs
implementation_notes: Architectural approach: a small runner (Go) executes golden prompts against baseline float model and quantized profile using the same seed/config where applicable. A metrics aggregator service computes per-sample metrics and reduces them to aggregated deltas. Summary artifacts written to S3 (or internal object store) and indexed in the QC index for dashboarding. The sentinel exposes a lightweight API for CI to fetch verdicts and for the rollout controller to query the latest stable verdict. We will reuse parts of the existing golden-replay infrastructure but add a delta-telemetry schema (summary schema v2).
tradeoffs: Sample size vs signal reliability: bigger stimulus sets reduce noise but increase runtime and cost
Per-model thresholds are more accurate but require bootstrapping; global thresholds are simpler but noisier
Deterministic sampling vs stochastic decoding: deterministic simplifies diffs but misses subtle generative regressions; choose beam/greedy + a sampled subset for diversity
Compute cost of nightly runs for Dedicated customers vs expected reduction in production incidents
test_plan: Create a small smoke stimuli set (200 prompts) covering high-sensitivity cases: long-context, rare tokens, structured outputs
Hook sentinel into PR pipeline for changes under /runtime/quant and block merges if verdict is fail (toggleable flag for initial rollout)
Run backfill on last 30 successful calibration merges to estimate baseline thresholds and false-positive rate
Add unit tests for delta computation functions (logprob delta, embedding cosine, ngram overlap)
Create e2e test that intentionally injects a controlled quantization perturbation to verify sentinel catches the regression
monitoring: Dashboard: /dashboards/quant-qc-sentinel (trend of pass rate, median deltas, top failing prompts)
Alert: if pass rate < 90% for the last 3 nightly runs -> #infra-quant-alerts (pager)
Alert: if single PR CI run fails -> slack channel #pr-ci-quant-fails (non-pager)
Telemetry retention: run summaries stored for 90 days; raw sample outputs retained for 14 days to limit PII surface
